metas.name: Perfect Liars
metas.description: Jude Derry arrives at the exclusive Tagus university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. What begins as revenge turns into a dangerous triangle of seduction, forbidden attraction and lies, drawing her toward a truth she may not be ready to face.

metas.name: Drive - The Pretenders
metas.description: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

metas.name: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
metas.description: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

metas.name: Last Meal
metas.description: The passionate love between pianist Sebahat and Bekir is cut short when he vanishes without a trace. Years later, when fate reunites them, they realize that neither time, distance, nor the life Sebahat has built could ever break their bond. Together, they embark on a journey that pushes the very limits of love, loyalty, and sacrifice because some loves are worth fighting for, no matter what.

metas.name: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
metas.description: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

metas.name: On Behalf of My Son
metas.description: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

metas.name: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
metas.description: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

metas.name: Primetime Preacher$
metas.description: Chronicles the 1980s golden age of Christian broadcasting, detailing how three of America's most prominent televangelists shifted evangelical Christianity into a massive political force.

metas.name: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
metas.description: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

metas.name: Expedition: Saving Our Seas
metas.description: Follows National Geographic Explorers investigating the global Ocean from seashore to seafloor as they chase discoveries and solutions needed to protect the seas amid rapid environmental change.

metas.name: When a Witness Recants
metas.description: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

metas.name: BTS: THE RETURN
metas.description: They're back! BTS gathers in LA to record their album "Arirang" in this documentary offering unprecedented access to the band as they enter a new era.

metas.name: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
metas.description: The rise, fall, and enduring legacy of Second City Television, one of the most influential sketch comedy series in television history. Through intimate interviews with surviving members of its cast and an emotional reunion in Toronto, it explores the creative partnership that transformed a small Canadian television production into a cultural phenomenon that launched some of comedy's most celebrated icons.

metas.name: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
metas.description: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story.

metas.name: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic
metas.description: Zainab Johnson has a gun revelation, a Tesla crisis and an unshakable belief that she can find the upside in everything in this sharp stand-up hour.

metas.name: Unbearable Christmas
metas.description: Out-of-work weatherman Troy Tipton has one Christmas mission: retrieve the beloved teddy bear he pawned for holiday cash. With wife Becca, mother-in-law Dawn, and the kids in tow, Troy hits the road from Ohio to Florida in his old news van. But the family road trip gets even wilder when they discover the cherished bear is actually a priceless Teddy Roosevelt antique worth millions.

metas.name: Frozen: Biggest Sledding Adventure Ever!
metas.description: Snow has arrived in Arendelle, and Anna and Olaf are excited for their first sled ride of the winter! When the hills aren't thrilling enough, Elsa uses her ice magic to create an epic sledding course filled with giant jumps, twists, and icy surprises. But when royal duties call Elsa away, Anna and Olaf come up with a special plan to bring the winter fun back and surprise their sister.

metas.name: LARA - The Man Who Took on Escobar
